samples.question: Welche Kernfunktionen müssen die Mock-ups der Simulationsübung mindestens demonstrieren?
samples.reference: The simulation-exercise mock-ups must demonstrate the listed core functionalities (map display, table display, and the rest).
reference_contexts: The proposed mock-ups shall demonstrate, at a minimum, the following core functionalities:
samples.answer: Die Mock-ups müssen mindestens eine geografische **Map display** zur länderbezogenen Identifikation und Erkundung sowie eine **Table display** demonstrieren; beide Darstellungen sollen auf Desktop und Mobilgeräten klar und nutzbar sein. Die abgerufenen Passagen brechen bei der Beschreibung der Tabellenfunktion ab, daher lässt sich die vollständige Liste der mindestens erforderlichen Kernfunktionen aus den vorliegenden Auszügen nicht abschließend bestimmen. Zusätzlich soll gezeigt werden, wie registrierte Nutzer ihre Erfahrung personalisieren und über neue länderbezogene Informationen informiert werden können.

samples.question: Wird ein Angebot abgelehnt, wenn der Zeitstempel der elektronischen Einreichung nach Ablauf der Frist liegt?
samples.reference: Late tenders are rejected; the eSubmission timestamp is the proof of timeliness.
reference_contexts: A tender received after this time-limit for receipt of tenders will be rejected.
samples.answer: Ja. Ein Angebot, dessen offizieller eSubmission-Zeitstempel nach der Frist liegt, wird abgelehnt; die Einreichungsbestätigung mit Datum und Uhrzeit gilt als Nachweis der fristgerechten Einreichung. Eine Einreichung über eSubmission ist nach Ablauf der Frist außerdem nicht möglich. Die Frist ist im Vergabebekanntmachung mit 12/10/2026 um 10:00:59 (UTC+02:00) angegeben.

At any moment during the procurement procedure, the Research Executive Agency Validation Services (hereafter _the EU Validation Services_ ) may contact the participant and ask for supporting documents on legal existence and status and financial capacity. The requests will be made through the register's messaging system to the e-mail address of the participant's contact person indicated in the register. Der Auftragnehmer und sein Personal müssen die jeweils geltenden Sicherheitsanforderungen der Agentur einhalten; dazu gehören insbesondere die EASA Security Baseline, die Berücksichtigung des Stands der Technik sowie der einschlägigen Risiken und die Umsetzung geeigneter technischer und organisatorischer Maßnahmen. # **1. Submission of tenders.** 

Tenders must be submitted exclusively via the electronic submission system (eSubmission) available from the above website<sup>3</sup> . Tenders submitted in any other way (e.g. e-mail or by letter) will be disregarded. 

In order to submit a tender using eSubmission, economic operators (each member of the group in the case of a joint tender) will need to register in the European Commission's <u>Participant Register</u> an online register of organisations participating in EU calls for tenders or proposals. On registering each organisation obtains a Participant Identification Code (PIC, 9-digit number) which acts as its unique identifier in the above register. Instructions on how to create a PIC can be found on this <u>page.</u> 

Economic operators already registered in the Participant Register shall reuse their existing PICs when preparing tenders in eSubmission.

###### **2.3. Registration in the Participant Register: why register?** 

Any economic operator willing to participate in this call for tenders must be registered in the <u>Participant Register</u> - an online register of organisations and natural persons (participants) participating in calls for tenders or proposals of the European Commission and other EU institutions/bodies. 

On registering each participant obtains a Participant Identification Code (PIC, 9-digit number), which acts as its unique identifier in the Participant Register. A participant needs to register only once – the information provided can be further updated or re-used by the participant in other calls for tenders or calls for proposals of the European Commission and other EU institutions/bodies. 

**Each participant needs to ensure that its SME status in the Participant Register is registered and kept up to date.** 

At any moment during the procurement procedure, the Research Executive Agency Validation Services (hereafter _the EU Validation Services_ ) may contact the participant and ask for supporting documents on legal existence and status and financial capacity. The requests will be made through the register's messaging system to the e-mail address of the participant's contact person indicated in the register. It is the responsibility of the participant to provide a valid e-mail address and to check it regularly. The documents that may be requested by _the EU Validation Services_ are listed in the EU <u>Grants and Tenders Rules on Legal Entity Validation, LEAR appointment and Financial Capacity assessment.</u> 

**Please note that a request for supporting documents by the** **_EU Validation Services_ in no way implies that the tenderer has been successful.**

##### **2. GENERAL INFORMATION ON TENDERING** 

###### **2.1. Legal basis: what are the rules?** 

This call for tenders is governed by the provisions of the Financial Regulation. 

The contracting authority has chosen to award the contracts resulting from this call for tenders through an open procedure pursuant to Article 167(1)(a) of the Financial Regulation. 

In this procedure any interested economic operator (any natural or legal person who offers to supply products, provide services or execute works) may submit a tender. 

###### **2.2.  Entities subject to restrictive measures and rules on access to procurement: who may submit a tender?** 

Tenderers must ensure that no involved entities (see Section 2.4) nor any subcontractors, including those which do not need to be identified in the tender (see Section 2.4.2), are subject to <u>EU restrictive measures</u> adopted under Article 29 of the Treaty on the European Union (TEU) or Article 215 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU (TFEU)<sup>5</sup> , consisting of a prohibition to make available or transfer funds or economic resources or to provide financing or financial assistance to them directly or indirectly, or of an asset freeze. The prohibition applies throughout the whole performance of the contract. 

This procurement procedure is open on equal terms to any natural or legal person wishing to bid for the assignment and established in any of the European Union Member States, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Switzerland.

###### **1.4.1. Background and objectives** 

The Agency primarily communicates with the outside world through its website, and it is therefore also the foundation of the communication strategy for outreach to the aviation professional and the general public. The communication department needs a dedicated framework contract to ensure the provision of a website which is robust and stable, allowing for quick, smooth publications. At the same time the platform must be constantly evolving and developing to allow the Agency to further enhance its digital presence. The contractor is expected to inspire and execute these developments, working hand-in-hand with our in-house web publication team. 

The Agency’s website serves approximately 21 million pageviews a year. The website uses Drupal as a content management system. The website is complex, supports content across 24 official EU languages with more than 45 content types, 30 taxonomies and 40.000 nodes.
